noun_definition: Chat refers to the messaging feature within the application where users can send and receive messages in reports.
Emoji picker refers to the user interface element that allows users to select and insert emojis into messages within the chat application.
Message refers to the text sent by a user in a report on the staging.new.expensify.com platform.
Context menu refers to a pop-up menu that appears upon right-clicking on a message, intended to provide additional options or actions related to that message.
